name: Mornh, Hammer of the Mountains

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus : +7 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Fracturing
effects.tooltip: Fracturing : This weapon is ideal for breaking bones and deals 2 to 12 damage to targets that have skeletons or are made of bone.

effects.name: Magma Surge
effects.tooltip: Magma Surge : This weapon stores the immeasurable heat of the planet's molten mantle. When this weapon is used, superheated magma occasionally surges to the surface, slowing an enemy down and inflicting massive fire damage over time.

effects.name: Stunning
effects.tooltip: Stunning +10 : +10 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist attempts.

effects.name: Seeker
effects.tooltip: Seeker +10 : Provides a +10 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +10 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).

customisation_hints.name: Attuned to Heroism
children: Attuned by Heroism: Tier 1 Adds Planar Conflux
Attuned by Heroism: Tier 2 +7 Enhancement Bonus → +8 Enhancement Bonus
Attuned by Heroism: Tier 3 Adds +0.5 weapon dice multiplier
Attuned by Heroism: Tier 4 Adds Red Augment Slot

flavor_text: Said to have been carried by a legendary dwarven paladin, the blows of this weighty hammer carry the very weight of the mountains themselves.

source.raw: Caught in the Web , End Chest
